title: synthrare_internal
summary: An internal, rough scaffold of ML training scripts that generate synthetic tabular data for aviation, finance, and healthcare domains. Each trainer script imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer, fitting the CTGAN-based synthesizer directly on the loaded dataframe to produce synthetic data models.
needs: PARSynthesizer is only mentioned in aviation_trainer.py's docstring as a fallback path; no call site for it was shown in the evidence, so its actual use is unverified.
